GRAPHICS
ON-SCREEN CONTROLS

The week

  • Six shifts, Monday to Saturday, at the pools you have opened. Every shift pays into the Date Fund 🍦. Fill it by Saturday night and Sunday is a date with Marina; fall short and it is game over, back to week 1. Week 4 ends with the season finale and the story's ending; the weeks go on after it, harder and harder.
  • Points make stars, stars make pay. Every swimmer you serve scores points; a happy streak multiplies them. Below the pass mark (on the scoreboard) a shift pays nothing. Each star pays more, and each of Marina's two wishes you meet pays extra.
  • The shop 🛍️ between shifts sells perks for the rest of the week, paid out of the Date Fund: spend now to earn more, or save for the date. A riskier gig pays more, not more points.
  • What you keep (🏅 Coach's locker, on the main screen): every date opens a new pool for good, stars earned in every run open gear for the coach to wear, and every date goes in the album.

On deck

  • Click a waiting swimmer, then a lane (or press 1–5). Click a swimmer already in the water and pick another lane to move them.
  • Carry one thing at a time. Walk to the gear and press E to pick it up, then E beside the swimmer, the water or the mess to use it. Fins and tubes come from their rack (F), chlorine (C), eye relief (R), the mop (Q).
  • Trouble gets a big sign with its steps (1 · NET, 2 · CATCH…) and a marker or an edge arrow showing where to go. Every save earns a stamp.
  • Two to a lane share; three swim in a circle, and fast swimmers get stuck behind slow ones. Keep speeds together and aqua aerobics out of the fast lanes.

The usual trouble

  • 🆘 Cramp: grab a glowing life ring (E), walk into the pool, swim it to them.
  • 💩 🚽 Tummy trouble: a swimmer with a warning bar: select them and Send home in time. Missed: skim the mess, empty the net in the bin, then chlorine.
  • 💧 Wet spot: mop it (Q), or anyone running over it slips, you too. Jump over it.
  • 🐟 Fish kid: stop the kid before the edge (E). Too late: net the fish, give it back.
  • 🐶 Loose dog: take the treats and lead it out through a door.
  • 💣 Cannonball man: show him the red card (E) before he reaches the edge.
  • ⚡ Power cut: when the lights flicker, run to the fuse box.
  • 😡 Karen: hold E beside her to calm her down.

Every pool has one rule of its own

  • 🏫 Community Pool: three lanes, the basics.
  • 🌴 Splash Park: daredevils want the trampoline (T). Clear lane 5 before they jump.
  • 🌅 Sunset Lagoon: five lanes; a storm can leave puddles on the deck.
  • 🏅 Aquatic Centre: fast swimmers, and Marco "the Missile" wants a clear lane.
  • 🪩 Aqua Disco: zones, not lanes: four dancers to a zone at most.
  • 🦆 Kids Pool: kids run loose: catch one (click or E), then POOL.
  • 👵 Senior Aqua Fit: slow walkers and wheelchairs; more cramps, keep a ring handy.
  • 🛟 Lazy River: hand everyone a tube (F), then RIVER. Rack the tubes they leave.
  • 🌊 Wave Pool: meet bathers with a tube; dizzy ones need help out. Z stops the wave machine.
  • 🌇 Rooftop Pool: margaritas from the bar (B), tidy the sunbeds, talk selfie-takers off the edge.
  • 🛳️ Cruise Ship: the deck tilts; keep people off the pool ends and straighten the loungers.
  • ♨️ Hot Springs: send cold guests to a spring (SPRING 1–4); shoo the monkeys; the ice is slippery.
  • 🏟️ Grand Gala Arena: five lanes, a big crowd and lots of VIPs.

WASD / arrows move · Space jump · Shift dash · E pick up / use / select · 1–5 a lane (or a zone, a spring, the pool, the river) · T trampoline · B the bar · Z the wave machine · F C R Q fins, chlorine, eye relief, mop · V Coach Cam (first-person view) · P / Esc pause · M music.
